content:
Several retailers are offering discounts on PlayStation 5 games, including deep price cuts on recent console-exclusive hits like Marvel’s Wolverine, Ghost of Yotei, Saros, and hundreds more. We’ll cover a bunch of those in the coming days, but this post is focused on the great hardware discounts that are happening, including $20 off the stellar DualSense wireless controller and its many color schemes, as well as $30 off the customizable DualSense Edge. The big sale also extends to headsets, console covers, and even Sony’s 27-inch monitor that has a hook to charge your controller.

Sitting out from the discounts, at least for now, are new PlayStation 5 consoles. It’s not impossible that a deal will surface later this month, though it’s more unlikely to happen than in past years for a couple of reasons. For one, console deals are exceedingly rare due to the rise in costs for the consoles associated with RAMageddon. Perhaps the bigger reason is Grand Theft Auto VI, a system-selling game launching November 19th that will likely convince a lot of people to pay full price for a console. Not to worry, though. We’ve included a link below for Sony-refurbished consoles that are cheaper than buying new.

Here are some of the best hardware-related deals we’ve seen from Sony’s PlayStation Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals.

Sony PlayStation 27-inch 1440p gaming monitor

The 1440p 240Hz refresh rate screen is sleek, but pretty basic for the price. It stands out, though, thanks to its DualSense-charging cradle that extends from its bottom. This is the first discount.

Where to Buy:

$349.99 $299.99 at Best Buy

$349.99 $299.99 at PlayStation Direct

Sony DualSense Wireless Controller

Some of the more basic color schemes of the DualSense are down to $54, including white, black, red, and blue.

Where to Buy:

$74.99 $54 at Amazon (multiple colors)

$74.99 $54 at Walmart (multiple colors)

$74.99 $54.99 at Best Buy (multiple colors)

Sony DualSense Edge

Both the white and midnight black versions of the DualSense Edge are discounted. Refurbished versions (with the same warranty as new controllers) are another $25 off.

Where to Buy:

$199.99 $169 at Amazon

$199.99 $169.99 at Best Buy

$199 $144 at PlayStation Direct (refurbished)

Sony PlayStation DualSense controller – Chroma series

If you’re seeking out a prettier DualSense, the Chroma series of controllers are just a few bucks more than the standard color schemes.

Where to Buy:

$79.99 $59.99 at Amazon

$79.99 $59.99 at Walmart

Sony PlayStation 5 slim (refurbished)

Save money where you can with a refurbished digital or disc-based console. Each has the same one-year warranty as getting a new console.

Where to Buy:

$499 at Sony (console w/o disc drive)

$549 at Sony (disc-based console)

Sony PlayStation Pulse Elite wireless gaming headset

Sony’s current top-end wireless gaming headset with planar magnetic drivers, active noise cancellation, and an extendable microphone.

Where to Buy:

$149 $109.99 at Amazon

$149 $109 at Best Buy

$149 $109 at PlayStation Direct

Sony PlayStation Pulse Explore wireless earbuds

For something more portable, the Pulse Explore earbuds still pack potent planar magnetic drivers, and can connect via Bluetooth or through Sony’s PlayStation Link protocol.

Where to Buy:

$199.99 $119 at Amazon

$199.99 $119.99 at Best Buy

$199.99 $119.99 at GameStop

Sony PlayStation 5 console covers

Adorn your PlayStation 5 slim console with something other than the white shells that are included. Prices vary depending on the style, going down to $39.

Where to Buy:

$59 $44 at PlayStation Direct (multiple colors)
